tweets.text:
You have officially lost your welcome!

Ecuadorian man awaiting immigration proceedings gets caught smuggling illegal aliens. 

Sunday 7/13, Border Patrol agents assigned to the Interstate 19 Immigration Checkpoint foiled a human smuggling attempt after they referred the occupants of a 2022 Chevy Malibu for secondary inspection. 

During the immigration inspection, agents learned the driver, from Ecuador, was smuggling the front passenger, a woman illegally present in the U.S. from Mexico. While securing the vehicle, agents also discovered a 43-year-old illegal alien from Mexico, concealed inside the trunk.

Criminal Database records ran on the driver revealed he entered the U.S. illegally from Mexico through California in January of 2024. He was encountered then with 70 other foreign national adults and was subsequently released on his own recognizance with a notice to appear, due to a lack of detention space caused by a migrant influx. 

 Now he will NOT be allowed to go anywhere as his smuggling endeavors have earned him a front row seat to federal prosecution for human smuggling. The man and woman being smuggled where placed into removal proceedings.   
 
Great Job Nogales Checkpoint crew!!!!!!

tweets.text:
No longer coming to a neighborhood near you!!

A previously deported gang member was arrested by Border Patrol on 7/17.  Not only had this Mexican National previously lived in the United States illegally, but he had also committed several crimes and even joined a gang.

This man had taken up residence in the #Memphis #Tennesseee and #Mississippi corridor where he got into trouble with the law for controlled substance and vehicular offenses, ultimately earning him a removal from the U.S. last month.

Now he will take a sobering ride in the passenger seat of an immigration removal flight, but only after his prosecution for illegal re-entry after deportation.

Great job Tucson Station!!
